en: is disordered love: love in the wrong order.
I may truly love my family,

text:
하나님보다 더 사랑하게 되면
그것은 *죄*가 됩니다
en: but love them more than God, and it becomes sin.
Say you love your family most:
"I'd give my life for my family."
Then either your family betrays you badly,

text:
아니면 자신이 그 가족을
너무 소중히 여겨서
en: or you treasure them so much

text:
둘 중에 한 가지가
되는 거예요

en: Jesus has to become more beautiful than the idol,
more lovely. That's what solves it.
It's not "I must stop loving the world."
Only when Christ's love goes deeper

text:
그 문제가 해결될 수
있는 거예요

더 *그리스도*께 나가는 것이
우리가 해야 될 일이죠
en: Our part is to come closer to Christ.
